units.source_text: 他在房间门口站着，月光下绽开着石榴花，他看着几个不修边幅的中国人在打麻将。

en.t: He stood in the doorway of the room; pomegranate blossoms were opening in the moonlight, and he watched several unkempt Chinese men playing mahjong.

units.source_text: 接着回到房间里，在低低的油灯下开始读《痴人的告白》。

en.t: Then he went back into the room and began reading Confessions of a Fool beneath the low oil lamp.

units.source_text: 但是读不上两页，就不由的苦笑起来。

en.t: But before he had read even two pages, he could not help smiling bitterly.

units.source_text: ——斯特林堡写给情妇伯爵夫人的信里，有一个和他差不多的谎言……

en.t: In a letter Strindberg wrote to his mistress, the countess, there was a lie much like his own...
